test_positional_selector_int: test the GroupBy._positional_selector with a single integer argument to select nth row per group
test_positional_selector_slice: test the GroupBy._positional_selector with a slice to select a range of rows per group
test_positional_selector_list: test the GroupBy._positional_selector with a list of integers to select specific rows per group
test_positional_selector_tuple: test the GroupBy._positional_selector with a tuple of ints and slices for mixed indexing
test_positional_selector_head_tail: test the GroupBy._positional_selector [:n] and [-n:] match grouped head and tail behavior
